intro: Cambodia has about 17 million people, most of them Khmer and Buddhist, with a young population.

chapters.title: People
text: Over 90% are Khmer. There are Cham Muslims, Vietnamese, Chinese and Indigenous highland peoples. Khmer has the longest alphabet in the world.
Because of the genocide, half the population is under about 30.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Phnom Penh is the capital, and Siem Reap is the gateway to Angkor.

keyTerms.meaning: The form of Buddhism practised in Cambodia.
